verdict.rationale: VLP's own Emerging Growth Companies & VC page lists angel/seed financings, venture capital financings and private equity investments, and says it prepares and negotiates equity issuance documentation. Its Executive Compensation page separately mentions representing founders in early- and late-stage financings. No page states deal volume or names representative transactions, and 'priced equity rounds' across stages is only implied. Missing for 10: stated deal volume or representative transactions, explicit coverage of priced rounds by stage (Series A through late stage) on the VC practice page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages

citations.quote: Angel investments and seed financings. Convertible debt and bridge loans. Venture capital financings. Strategic partnering and investments. Private equity investments.
we prepare and negotiate the financing documentation covering the issuance of equity and debt securities.
Representing founders and entrepreneurs in connection with early and late-stage financings, buyouts, IPOs, company sales and departures.
